concept: S3 bucket policy: aws:PrincipalOrgID condition to restrict access to the org
tests: How to guarantee a bucket can be accessed only by principals inside the AWS Organization.
expected: Bucket policy with an aws:PrincipalOrgID condition (Deny if not our org) + SCP guardrails at the organization level. Triggers: "outside their AWS Organization", "regardless of other policies", "organization-wide".
why_not: Block Public Access blocks public access but not specific external accounts; ACLs — legacy and coarse; Object Lock — about retention, not principals.
